source_findings.finding: power_regions is a list used with numeric region handle IDs, without demonstrated dense positional bounds; retired removal also uses numeric value subtraction.

classification: Reference and native both log millions of bounds errors. Missing native debug origins demonstrably change runtime reporting/silencing semantics; specific power event causality remains unresolved. Fewer failed tests do not establish correctness.
next_evidence: Source-aware native error reporting and equal-event-stream/captured-payload replay would be needed for causal proof; no new runtime was launched in this investigation.

runtime_reporting.mechanism: Frozen /world/Error writes runtime-errors.log before cooldown, then uses erroruid=[E.file][E.line]. A silenced bucket returns before GLOB.error_cache, world.log, GLOB.current_test.Fail and log_runtime. Native missing debug origins therefore collapse unrelated sites into one blank file/line cooldown bucket.

native_global_debug_scan.result: Both exit 0, empty stdout: no decoded non-reserved procedure contains DbgFile or DbgLine.

runtime_reporting.startup: Native dq_lifecycle_time errors have blank file/line; stderr line342 reports silencing for 10 minutes. Reference lifecycle errors have transaction.dm:101. Reference power errors at power_bridge.dm:85 and :107 occur at 03:13:37, before later retired-branch :154 test failures.
runtime_reporting.limit: Raw native bounds messages have blank origins and empty descriptions. Their similar count does not prove which procedures failed or equal event streams. The apparent absence of native errors/per-test failures is not trustworthy parity evidence.

header_difference.external_library_flag_evidence: Existing feature_load_ext.native.bin and feature_call_ext.native.bin each have 0x20000340; feature_dynamic_call.native.bin has 0x340. header_difference.qualification: Header/compat differences are hypotheses for investigation, not evidence that the bit changes event payload or disables FFI.
